method: Read all 284 architecture, migration, CI and acceptance-report propositions, all 56 complete context profiles, eight exact caption occurrence sets and the full ordered CI sequence. Each full original payload and all 1,385 ordered occurrence bindings are verified against immutable evidence and source bytes. All archived logical inputs are read directly from the hash-pinned durable archive with exact regular-member name, byte-length and digest validation; no implementation or generator is read and no large overlay extraction occurs. The additive caption-count clarification is checked against the actual eight original IDs. Fixed owner/encoding/order/evidence-field rules are distinguished from current semantic coverage and required acceptance outcomes.

decisions.PRESERVED_FIXED_BOUNDARIES: Every exact fixed architecture/stage/run boundary retains its original demonstrated-failing-case and narrowly justified correction condition. F1 adds conditional pairs within the thirty stages, not a Stage31. C1 uses the existing bounded decoder and preserves response transport; D authorizes only declared data semantics, not a redundant framework/parser/engine. A/B/E use existing authority paths. Standalone file-first handoff and noncanonical previews remain independently governed.
decisions.PRESERVED_RUNTIME_ORDER: The exact nine-item dependency order, same-origin worker entry, one shared build/cache identity and loader prohibitions remain. D semantic identity changes and C1 isolated intake grant no alternate runtime graph or stale worker. One-time repair removal remains conditional on integrated regression-proven behavior, with diagnostics/migration/acceptance/live verification preserved.
decisions.PRESERVED_CSP: The restrictive CSP and sole same-origin declared worker allowance remain. Every original arbitrary script/worker/network/evaluation/inline/third-party prohibition remains. Bounded data processing in C1/D and conditional routes in F1/F2 grant no expanded execution or network authority.
decisions.PRESERVED_OWNERSHIP: The individually specified schema/runtime/engine/store/UI/CI owners remain. A–F2 changes owned content, not sole authority. Safe rendering, closed URLs, file-first actions and human confirmation remain. Retaining an owner atom does not assert that its current complete derivation, schema or tests are unchanged.
decisions.PRESERVED_IDENTITY_AND_HISTORY: The literal workflow/schema/stage/profile identities, exact deterministic legacy path and shortcut equivalence of both canonical result and audit history remain. Every named original/raw/canonical/byte/history object remains preserved. Legacy/imported duplicate state is historical/nongating; equal names cannot establish semantic compatibility or fabricate current proof.
decisions.PRESERVED_REGISTRY_BINDING: Every individually named contract and registry remains controlling and version-bound, with archive conditionality preserved. Changed D semantics/E normalization and other amendments require appropriate compatibility or invalidation under the existing rule. A /1 label or an input echo is not equivalence evidence; no new authority follows from an accounting locator.
decisions.PRESERVED_MIGRATION_HONESTY: Exact profile-name/legacy classification, idempotence and every prohibition on fabricated semantic review, authority, execution, evidence, freshness, independence, backup, mobile or delivery facts remain. E requires verified accepted provenance and the actual observation, never a backdated freeze. Missing release-bearing facts stay UNKNOWN/incomplete; current completeness/validator duties are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_CI_SEQUENCE_AND_POLICY: One Pages workflow, main-only production deploy, no redundant PR deploy, exact ordered proof/deploy/browser/physical-device/publication/tag sequence and required PR test job remain. Unknown branch protection is reported unproven. These ordering/governance atoms do not establish that old coverage or a successful job meets amended semantics; no CI state was read.
decisions.PRESERVED_ACCEPTANCE_ARTIFACT_SHAPE: The exact acceptance fields, current artifact identities and physical-device tuple/basis obligations remain, including only the stated hardware-model/WebKit UNKNOWN exception. Field presence or a digest is not proof. Current semantic coverage and required semantic triggers are separate changed atoms; actual physical device, challenge and deployment binding remain mandatory.
decisions.PRESERVED_REPOSITORY_BOUNDARY: Exact source/specification/normative manifests remain reviewed repository CI evidence outside ordinary runtime state and external prompts. A–F2 runtime values do not authorize injection of implementation instructions or repair commentary into project content. Actual current artifact identity is required; no implementation/proof acceptance follows.
decisions.EXACT_BOUNDED_GOVERNOR_AND_ORDER: All eight captions retain their individual exact original governed sets, including the ordered nineteen-step proof/deploy/publication/tag sequence. Bounded list captions do not absorb adjacent standalone contracts or reviewer extensions. Changed child duties remain separately changed; a retained caption is not unchanged semantic coverage. The author prose seven-caption count is corrected by its additive clarification and verified against eight original IDs.
decisions.CURRENT_PROFILE_MIGRATION_AND_VALIDATOR: Actual current-profile completeness, validation and invalid-legacy coverage now consume A request/answer closure, B reviewed availability, C/C1 occurrence accounting, D native semantics, E normalized snapshot and F1/F2 conditional route/input duties. High-level schema equality supplies no compatibility or missing facts. Auditable equivalent representation migration preserves source and actual observation; otherwise retain historical/nongating state.
decisions.CURRENT_RELEASE_TAG_ACCEPTANCE_PREREQUIS: The actual current tests, deployed-browser and physical-iPhone acceptance required before tagging must cover applicable amended semantic behavior and current identities, including A invalid/valid answer controls and F1/F2 route/input gates. The required order, live deployed byte identity and physical-device evidence boundary remain. Prior coverage cannot be relabeled current.
decisions.CURRENT_DERIVATION_COVERAGE: Actual reported current derivation, completed-stage, negative-case and terminal-command coverage evaluates amended acceptance/accounting/completeness/due-test/execution/evidence predicates. Unchanged report field names do not establish unchanged semantic coverage. Stage count, owners, evidence strength and ordering remain; source review is no proof promotion.
decisions.CURRENT_RELATIONSHIP_COVERAGE: Current relationship coverage includes A affected-context references with no write grant, B nested owning-record proofExpressions reference resolved by the single ingestion path, and E one current resolved test relation with exact equivalent-form agreement and provenance. Canonical identity and writer ownership remain application-controlled.
decisions.CURRENT_INTAKE_AND_OBLIGATION_COVERAGE: Current raw-input accounting, semantic mapping and downstream obligation coverage retain every C/C1 supplied physical/structural occurrence and exact original/verified child bytes, authorized mapping and bounded failure outcomes, with A human input where applicable. Old nonempty inventories and hashes do not establish completeness; unknown remaining units cannot become zero.
decisions.CURRENT_ACCEPTED_VALUE_EXTRACTION_COVERA: Current extraction coverage includes A request items, B proof relation proposals, D admitted definitions/results, E exact normalization/provenance and F1/F2 route/input/receipt content where applicable. Raw retention, application identity, owning writers and extraction before acceptance remain. An echoed input or unsupported route cannot replace complete extraction/validation.
decisions.CURRENT_SCOPE_AND_NATIVE_EXECUTION_COVER: Actual current-scope/native coverage binds amended input/proof/native/variance identities and current compatible F1 context, with F2 actual observed native input custody before execution and only its specified external minimum. D definition/data/worker/result distinctions require matching current cases. Fixed executor, stronger proof and source linkage requirements remain.
decisions.CURRENT_DUE_AND_EMPTY_UNIVERSE_COVERAGE: Due and empty-universe coverage evaluates exactly F1 conditional pairs under B accepted target availability and F2 applicable input basis, preserving reviewed compatibility/history/phase and all original due conditions. A now-due obligation cannot disappear into an empty denominator; future/UNKNOWN targets cannot be executed or treated as known absence.

qualifier: The separately accepted technical-reference interpretation resolves policy meaning in its exact attributed scope. These historical reference qualifiers are preserved pending explicit per-entry effective-dependency and typed-governor linkage review; they are not a claim that the normative input remains missing or an automatic scope-wide identity change.
